sloka: जीवन्नद्य विपन्नो ऽस्मि नष्टराज्यमनोरथः ।प्राप्तप्रतिज्ञश्च रिपुः सकामो रावणः कृतः ।। ६.५०.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: jīvannadya vipanno 'smi naṣṭarājyamanorathaḥ ।prāptapratijñaśca ripuḥ sakāmo rāvaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 6.50.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having lost my life ambition for the kingdom, frustrated I am. My enemy Ravana, having succeeded in his vow, did this deed."
